Title: Initialize monorepo with workspaces
Body: Goal: Create apps/api, apps/web, packages/contracts, infra. Acceptance: workspaces detected; CI build runs.

Title: Docker Compose: Postgres,Redis,Elasticsearch
Body: Goal: Single-node dev stack. Acceptance: docker compose up -d starts services; health reachable.

Title: NestJS skeleton with health endpoint
Body: Goal: /api/v1/health returns { ok: true }. Acceptance: unit test for health.

Title: Wire Drizzle to Postgres and migrations
Body: Goal: Drizzle ORM + drizzle-kit. Acceptance: first migration applied; notes in README.

Title: Remix app bootstrapped
Body: Goal: Index page renders and can call API. Acceptance: shows API health.

Title: CI setup (GitHub Actions) for build
Body: Goal: Build API & Web on push. Acceptance: CI green on main.

Title: IAM schema and user table
Body: Goal: iam.users with unique email, password hash, role. Acceptance: migration applied.

Title: Register + Login endpoints with JWT
Body: Endpoints: POST /auth/register, POST /auth/login. Acceptance: access+refresh; bcrypt.

Title: Refresh token + /me endpoint
Body: Endpoints: POST /auth/refresh, GET /me. Acceptance: refresh rotates; /me returns profile.

Title: RBAC guard (customer/seller/admin)
Body: Goal: role-based protection. Acceptance: wrong role rejected.

Title: Catalog schemas (products,categories,fitment)
Body: Tables with indexes. Acceptance: migration applied; seed present.

Title: Product CRUD (seller/admin)
Body: Endpoints: GET/POST /catalog/products etc. Acceptance: create/list paginated.

Title: Fitment filter endpoint
Body: Endpoint: GET /catalog/fitment?make&model&year&engine. Acceptance: correct subset.

Title: Seed script for categories/products/fitment
Body: Goal: populate dev DB. Acceptance: idempotent; documented.

Title: Remix: product list + detail pages
Body: Goal: SSR list + detail. Acceptance: loader uses API; paginated.

Title: Inventory schema and endpoints
Body: Table: inventory(product_id, seller_id, qty). Endpoints: GET stock, SET stock.

Title: Reservation interface for checkout
Body: Goal: reserve/release with idempotency. Acceptance: no double-decrement.

Title: Remix: seller inventory UI
Body: Goal: table+form to update stock. Acceptance: auth required; persists.

Title: Inventory contention tests
Body: Goal: simulate concurrent reservations. Acceptance: tests prove correctness.

Title: Elasticsearch index + mapping
Body: Goal: product index with filter fields. Acceptance: index ready.

Title: Index on product upsert
Body: Goal: in-proc event to ES. Acceptance: new product searchable in seconds.

Title: Search API with filters
Body: Endpoint: GET /search?q&category&make&model&year&engine&page&size. Acceptance: ranked results.

Title: Zero-result analytics
Body: Goal: log queries with no hits. Acceptance: view or dashboard exists.

Title: Orders schema (carts,orders,items,statuses)
Body: Goal: base tables. Acceptance: migration applied.

Title: Cart API (add/list)
Body: Endpoints: POST /cart/items, GET /cart. Acceptance: multi-seller cart.

Title: Checkout transaction (atomic)
Body: Goal: reserve stock, create order, clear cart. Acceptance: all-or-nothing; idempotent.

Title: Order detail + status timeline
Body: Endpoint: GET /orders/:id. Acceptance: items+sellers+history.

Title: Remix: cart + checkout pages
Body: Goal: E2E from cart to order. Acceptance: errors handled; empty cart UX.

Title: Payments schema & ledger
Body: Tables: intents, holds, captures, refunds, payout_ledger. Acceptance: audit trail.

Title: PaymentsPort interface + sandbox adapter
Body: Goal: abstract Telebirr/HelloCash; implement sandbox. Acceptance: unit tests.

Title: Authorize hold at checkout
Body: Flow: order pending → hold created. Acceptance: failure rolls back.

Title: Capture on delivery / Release on cancel
Body: Flow: delivered→capture; cancel→release/refund. Acceptance: idempotent.

Title: Payout report (commission)
Body: Goal: seller earnings minus commission. Acceptance: CSV export.

Title: Notification service (email/SMS stub)
Body: Goal: provider abstraction; dev logs. Acceptance: triggers on key events.

Title: Order lifecycle notifications
Body: Events: placed, shipped, delivered. Acceptance: logged/sent.

Title: Reviews schema & API
Body: Endpoint: POST /reviews (after delivered), GET /reviews. Acceptance: moderation flag.

Title: Remix: review form & list
Body: Goal: post-purchase review UX. Acceptance: eligible orders only.

Title: Admin dashboard (approve sellers
Body: Route: /admin. Acceptance: role-guarded; basic tables. moderate listings)

Title: Seller dashboard (listings
Body: Route: /seller. Acceptance: auth; CRUD flows. inventory

Title: SSR auth guard for Remix routes
Body: Goal: protect loaders with JWT cookies. Acceptance: unauth → login.

Title: Design system pass (Tailwind components)
Body: Goal: table, form, badge, modal primitives. Acceptance: reusable.

Title: Global + per-route rate limiting
Body: Goal: token bucket; strict on auth & payments. Acceptance: load test throttles.

Title: CORS,cookies,CSRF posture
Body: Goal: same-origin prod; secure httpOnly cookies; CSRF if needed. Acceptance: checklist ticked.

Title: Input validation & output encoding audit
Body: Goal: class-validator everywhere; XSS-safe outputs. Acceptance: lint rule for DTOs.

Title: Secrets management & HTTPS
Body: Goal: no secrets in repo; enforce HTTPS. Acceptance: env review done.

Title: Pen-test checklist & fixes
Body: Goal: address XSS/CSRF/SQLi findings. Acceptance: 0 high/critical left.

Title: Structured logging with requestId
Body: Goal: correlate logs per request/user. Acceptance: format documented.

Title: Error tracking (Sentry) for API & web
Body: Goal: capture exceptions with context. Acceptance: test error visible.

Title: Health checks for DB/Redis/ES
Body: Goal: /health includes dependency status. Acceptance: fails fast if down.

Title: Basic metrics dashboard
Body: Goal: req/s, p95 latency, DB pool, cache hit rate. Acceptance: dashboard saved.

Title: Response caching for hot GETs
Body: Goal: Redis-backed cache; keys/TTL documented. Acceptance: hit rate tracked.

Title: DB index review & N+1 fixes
Body: Goal: add/adjust indexes; batch queries. Acceptance: k6 shows improvements.

Title: k6 load test: search,list,checkout
Body: Goal: scripts + results. Acceptance: budgets met.

Title: Image optimization & CDN plan
Body: Goal: WebP/AVIF and sizes; choose CDN. Acceptance: improved CLS/LCP.

Title: E2E tests for top 10 flows
Body: Goal: Cypress/Playwright suite. Acceptance: green in CI.

Title: Backup & restore drill
Body: Goal: nightly pg_dump + verified restore.

Title: Go-Live runbook & rollback plan
Body: Goal: incident contacts, playbooks.

Title: Policies published (ToS/Privacy/Seller)
Body: Goal: pages live and linked.
